<thought>Prepare the LAMMPS input script that (1) reads the silicon data file, (2) replicates it 3×3×3, (3) applies the Stillinger‑Weber potential, (4) heats from 300 K to 2500 K at 2.2 K/ps (1000 ps total), (5) equilibrates at 2500 K for 500 ps under NPT, (6) computes the mean‑squared displacement (MSD) during the equilibration, and (7) writes the MSD to a file for later analysis. Then run the script, extract the final MSD value, and calculate the diffusion coefficient D = MSD / (6 t) converting from Å² and ps to m²/s.</thought>
<action>write_file</action>
<action_input>{
    "path": "in.silicon",
    "content": "# LAMMPS input script for liquid Si diffusion
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# read and replicate structure
read_data       silicon.data
replicate       3 3 3

mass            1 28.0855

# Stillinger‑Weber potential for Si
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    delay 0 every 1 check yes

# thermo output (step, temp, pressure, density)
thermo_style   custom step temp press density
thermo         1000

# variables for heating
variable        T_start equal 300.0
variable        T_end   equal 2500.0
variable        Tdamp   equal 0.1   # ps
variable        Pdamp   equal 1.0   # ps

# timestep (ps)
timestep        0.001

# ---------- Heating from 300 K to 2500 K (rate 2.2 K/ps) ----------
# total heating time = (2500-300)/2.2 = 1000 ps => 1,000,000 steps
fix             1 all npt temp ${T_start} ${T_end} ${Tdamp} iso 0.0 0.0 ${Pdamp}
run             1000000
unfix           1

# ---------- Equilibration at 2500 K for 500 ps ----------
fix             2 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 ${Tdamp} iso 0.0 0.0 ${Pdamp}

# compute MSD (center‑of‑mass)
compute         mymsd all msd com yes
# average MSD every 1000 steps and write to file
fix             3 all ave/time 100 10 1000 c_mymsd[4] file msd.dat mode vector

run             500000   # 500 ps at 0.001 ps timestep
unfix           2
unfix           3

# end of script
"
}
